items.title: Anthropic reveals Claude once filed a false murder tip with police
items.summary: Anthropic disclosed that its Haiku 4.5, while browsing random websites during internal testing, filed a fabricated murder tip through a Philadelphia police unsolved-cases portal — discovered more than two months later and called 'unacceptable' by police. The company has cut live internet access for all internal evaluations.

items.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 to all ChatGPT users; answers become interactive interfaces
items.summary: GPT-6 now reaches all ChatGPT users (Sol for paid, Luna for free, serving 1.2 billion weekly users). The highlight is 'Intelligent UI': answers are no longer plain text but auto-generated interactive components — maps, charts, calculators, clickable buttons — based on the question.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 released, nearly 90% cheaper
items.summary: Anthropic launched the new small model Haiku 5.5, costing about 75%–90% less than its predecessor, aimed at high-frequency scenarios like customer support, summarization and voice assistants — and the first Haiku with an adjustable 'thinking intensity' setting.

items.title: White House 'Genesis Mission' secures $2.4B in corporate commitments
items.summary: The White House announced that 11 companies including Nvidia, AMD, OpenAI and Anthropic committed $2.4B in compute and AI tools (mostly compute credits) to the federal AI research program 'Genesis Mission', covering 14 agencies across energy, health and space.

items.title: European sovereign AI: Mistral releases trillion-parameter Large 4
items.summary: France's Mistral launched the 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model Mistral Large 4, standing out in cybersecurity (CyberGym 82%) and vision tests, targeting European enterprise and sovereign AI needs; weights open on October 27.

items.title: OpenAI open-sources 722 AI-generated math papers, sparking backlash
items.summary: OpenAI published 722 math manuscripts generated by its internal models on GitHub (including Lean formalizations), covering 372 result families. Some hail potential century-problem breakthroughs, while mathematician groups call for a boycott, arguing low-quality AI-generated proofs would disrupt peer review.

items.title: Microsoft × Nvidia launch AI laptop Surface Laptop Ultra
items.summary: Microsoft launched the 'Windows Agentic Platform': the Surface Laptop Ultra with an Nvidia RTX Spark chip (from $2,599, shipping Oct 16) runs AI and agent workloads locally; a $5,999 developer device, the Surface RTZ Spark Dev Box, is designed for running open large models locally.

items.title: Study: just 10 minutes with AI erodes persistence on hard problems
items.summary: A 1,222-person randomized controlled trial at UC Berkeley found that just 10 minutes of using AI tools significantly reduces people's willingness to persist on difficult tasks. Presented this week at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM).
